name: SAFFRON

attributes.task: Evaluate whether embeddings from spatial transcriptomics foundation models, single-cell foundation models or gene expression capture a known measure of spatial variation. A Matryoshka sparse autoencoder with BatchTopK sparsity is trained on the embeddings Z. The score is the maximum |Spearman rho| between any SAE feature and the spatial measure tau, per spatial domain for global tasks and per sample for local tasks. Orthogonal matching pursuit runs when |rho| >= 0.3 to find a minimal reconstructing feature set.
